what: End-to-end runs of production OCR models on part H's own test pages
why: H5 measured a two-stage detect-then-recognise pipeline on these pages and attributed 99.98% of its error to the interface between the stages. H6 priced deleting that interface from published configs. These are the models H6 costed, run on the same pages against the same ground truth, so the pipeline comparison is a measurement rather than an argument -- and so H6's arithmetic is audited against a loaded model rather than against itself.

pages.source: src/mlladder/synth.py documents(), the H5 test split: rng seed 0, 2500 train pages drawn first so page k here is page k of H5's test set
pages.upscale: LANCZOS 4x -- adds no information, so ground truth is unchanged; it only removes the excuse that the page is smaller than the model's patch grid

scoring: parts/h_computer_vision/h3_crnn_ctc.py character_error_rate / word_error_rate, one transcript per page with lines joined in reading order -- the same functions and the same construction H5 scores its pipeline with

runs.note: emits grounding boxes inline as <|det|>label [x1, y1, x2, y2]<|/det|> before each line's text; the transcript is what remains once those are stripped
returns an empty transcript on several pages at this resolution rather than reading them wrongly

candle reports the geometry itself: 1024x640 -> 1036x644, 46 x 74 patches, which is 3404 patches and 851 tokens after the 2x2 merge -- an independent confirmation of H6's corrected ceiling, from a different implementation
identical to the transformers run to every digit, and the single error is the same one: page 5 has two identical SIGMA lines and both implementations emit one

runs.failures: page 2 returns an empty transcript; page 9 emits a spurious 'Text pro' line
runs.note: the transformers run scored 0.0000 on these pages using the model's own infer(), which tiles at crop_mode=True -- so this gap is preprocessing, not runtime

worse than the global view at 6.6x the image tokens. The tiled path only runs at all after two batch fixes (see candle-patches); the grid choice is evidently not what the reference does for a 1024x640 page.

not_run.note: the decoder runs and what could not be run among them are recorded in c-real-models.json

cross_implementation_check.claim: candle and transformers agree exactly on this model and these pages
cross_implementation_check.shared_failure: page 5, whose two lines are both 'SIGMA'; both runtimes emit one line, so the native-resolution error is a repeated-line collapse rather than a misreading
cross_implementation_check.why_it_matters: two independent implementations of the same weights reaching the same CER to 16 digits means the number is a property of the model, not of a runtime

candle_build.why_compute_cap: pinning the T4's sm_75 builds one architecture's PTX instead of every architecture candle knows about
candle_build.note: 37s to add the gemma4 and deepseekv2 examples once the tree is warm, so the cost is the first build, not the model
fixes_needed: candle-kernels/src/compatibility.cuh defines __hmax_nan/__hmin_nan under `#if __CUDA_ARCH__ < 800`, but CUDA 12.8 already defines them for arch >= 530, so nvcc fails on src/affine.cu. Adding `&& CUDART_VERSION < 12000` to the guard fixes it.
--bf16 on an sm_75 card fails with DriverError(CUDA_ERROR_NOT_FOUND, 'named symbol not found'): candle's bf16 kernels need sm_80. Running without it works.
segment_anything/image_encoder.rs adds the learned pos_embed with `+`, which needs equal shapes; a batch of crops is [n, h, w, c] against the grid's [1, h, w, c]. broadcast_add.
unlimited_ocr/vision.rs forward_crops cats a transposed tensor and hands the result to a batched matmul, which rejects the strides. .contiguous().
a tar that preserves mtimes older than the previous build makes cargo skip the rebuild silently -- extract with -m. This cost one run that reported a stale binary's CLI.
candle_build.cpu_build: still impossible on this branch: qwen3_5, gemma4 and unlimited_ocr call candle_nn::fused::static_decode, which is behind #[cfg(feature = "cuda")], from call sites that are not, so a build without --features cuda fails with 51 errors in candle-transformers
